claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the machine wrapped in plastic; no location/usage history evidence.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include any powered-on test, menu/screens, or functional checks.
Witness identity section reads brand SHARP and model AR-M207 from the front panel/model label in Photos 0–2.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says M307 while witness read AR-M207). Wrong model affects price and compatibility of parts/toner/drivers.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the exact model label (including full model code) and the control panel model/about screen after removing plastic.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case for the buyer: treat as AR-M207 only (or as uncertain model) and discount accordingly until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on test; fully wrapped). Could be dead, jammed, or have faults.
risks.proof: Video/clip of power-on showing no error codes, plus a successful copy/print test page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until a successful copy/print is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Consumables/drum/toner condition unknown; could be near end-of-life or require immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum status indicators or service/consumables counters from the machine menu (after powering on).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case consumable wear (assume toner/drum may need replacement soon).

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage under plastic (dents, cracks, missing parts) not visible in the wrapped photos.
risks.proof: Photos after removing plastic from all sides and corners, including paper tray areas and output tray.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs inspection until plastic is removed and damage is ruled out.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables/trays (paper trays, output tray, power cable, manuals) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out: power cable, all trays, output tray, any network/USB accessories, manuals, and packaging contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing or incomplete accessories and discount for buyer to source them.

risks.risk: Connectivity and scanning/printing over LAN/USB may not work (ports not shown; network setup unknown).
risks.proof: Photo of rear ports plus a clip showing LAN/USB connection and a successful scan/print over the chosen method.
risks.if_unproven: Price as basic local use only (or as limited functionality) until connectivity is proven.

proof_requests: Remove the plastic and take clear photos of the full model label (exact code) and the control panel 'About/Model' screen.
Power on and show a short video: no error codes, then a successful copy/print test page.
Show consumables status/counters (toner/drum life) from the machine menu.
Provide photos of all trays/covers and confirm all accessories are included (power cable, output tray, manuals).
Show rear ports (USB/LAN/Wi‑Fi if present) and demonstrate one working connection method (LAN or USB) with a print/scan test.
response.reason: The witness can identify the brand/model as SHARP AR-M207, but the seller’s model claim conflicts and the photos show the unit fully wrapped with no proof of power-on/printing, consumables, accessories, or connectivity. Without those proof points, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
